name: AMLSim
what: Simulator that writes synthetic bank transactions containing money-laundering patterns, for training detectors.

bare.edit: the request alone: no description, nothing added to the README

use.context: Some context: I'm on the financial crime team. We use our fork of this simulator to generate synthetic bank transactions that contain money-laundering patterns, such as fan-in, fan-out and cycles, hidden among normal activity. The detection team trains and benchmarks our anti-money-laundering models on these datasets, and the results go into the risk review.
